facts.fact: The digest states the Cyber Security Authority was created under the 2020 Cybersecurity Act and oversees cybersecurity.
The digest states the CSA adopted the National Cybersecurity Policy in October 2024; no period is given.

The digest states the Ministry of Communications and Digitalisation issued a notice in September 2021 designating ICT, banking, energy and health service providers as critical information infrastructure.
The digest states a CSA Directive of October 2021 requires designated critical infrastructure entities to report incidents within 24 hours.
